pick.headline: Loma Prieta earthquake strikes San Francisco
pick.summary: On October 17, 1989, an earthquake struck the San Francisco Bay Area during a World Series game, killing sixty-three people and collapsing part of the Bay Bridge.
pick.significance: Gorbachev's government, which had received US help after the Armenian earthquake ten months earlier, offered assistance.
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of October 19, 1989, carried Buenos Aires TELAM: President Menem sent Bush the Argentine people's condolences over the earthquake that hit San Francisco.
